debian_pending.reason: Temporary acceptance of exact previously reviewed Debian findings still present in the 2026-11-21 amd64 image. Some are real risks when processing untrusted input or using privileged operations; see .devcontainer/security-review-2026-11-21.md and linked prior reviews. Reassess packages and vendor fixes before expiry.

debian_new.reason: Temporary acceptance of exact Git, Expat, SQLite, OpenSSL, libslirp, fzf, rsync, and sudo findings in the 2026-11-21 amd64 scan. Several affect real input or network boundaries; avoid untrusted inputs as described in .devcontainer/security-review-2026-11-21.md. The rsync and sudo attributions appear inconsistent with Debian's fixed-version tables and need scanner recheck. Reassess each fingerprint before expiry.

kerberos_runtime.reason: Temporary acceptance of exact Kerberos runtime package attributions. KDC and administration server packages are absent from the inventory, but this does not establish every library path unreachable; client authorization-data handling remains a concern. See .devcontainer/security-review-2026-11-21.md; reassess each advisory and Debian status before expiry.

kernel_headers.reason: Exact 2026-11-21 linux-libc-dev userspace-header attributions. The package does not supply the running kernel; this disposition does not assess host configuration or backports. Host applicability for the 40 advisory IDs is tracked under cos-dam4. See .devcontainer/security-review-2026-11-21.md.

libxml2_pending.reason: Temporary acceptance of exact libxml2 and development-package fingerprints, including CRITICAL CVE-2026-6653. Debian reports the scanned Trixie version vulnerable without a Trixie fix. Do not process untrusted XML; see .devcontainer/security-review-2026-11-21.md and linked prior reviews.

openssh_pending.reason: Temporary acceptance of exact OpenSSH client-package fingerprints, including CRITICAL CVE-2026-60002. Client vulnerabilities remain real when connecting to untrusted servers or using untrusted usernames; server-only attribution requires separate executable confirmation. Debian reports no Trixie fix. See .devcontainer/security-review-2026-11-21.md and prior linked reviews.

go_binaries.reason: Temporary acceptance of exact findings in the scanned amd64 Go executables. Module versions alone do not establish reachable paths; linked code and TLS or network exposure remain concerns. PRs #558 and #562 fix many Dolt and beads findings and must be merged promptly after validation. See .devcontainer/security-review-2026-11-21.md and linked prior reviews; remove fixed entries and reassess residual findings before expiry.
